user.title: Add Energiedirect
user.description: Choose what to set up. Dynamic prices need no login; your account gives your own tariffs, usage, costs and budget bill. You can add both.

dynamic_prices.title: Energiedirect dynamic prices
dynamic_prices.description: Adds the public hourly electricity, gas and feed-in prices from energiedirect.nl, for today and tomorrow. No login needed.

account.title: Connect Mijn Energiedirect
account.description:
Energiedirect's login page requires a captcha, so log in yourself and hand over the session:

1. Open a **private/incognito window** and log in at {portal_url}
2. Press F12, open the **Network** tab and reload the page
3. Click a request to `mijn.energiedirect.nl/api/...`, and under **Request Headers** copy the whole value of **cookie**
4. Paste it below, then close the private window **without logging out**

reconfigure.title: Replace Energiedirect session
reconfigure.description:
Paste the cookie header of a fresh Mijn Energiedirect session, for example after you logged out or want to use a different login. It must belong to the same account.

1. Open a **private/incognito window** and log in at {portal_url}
2. Press F12, open the **Network** tab and reload the page
3. Click a request to `mijn.energiedirect.nl/api/...`, and under **Request Headers** copy the whole value of **cookie**
4. Paste it below, then close the private window **without logging out**

error.no_cookies: That doesn't look like a cookie header.
error.invalid_session: This session is not logged in or has expired. Log in again and copy fresh cookies.

abort.wrong_account: These cookies belong to a different Energiedirect account.
abort.nothing_to_configure: Dynamic prices have nothing to configure.

api_changed_supply_addresses.title: Energiedirect changed its addresses and contracts data
api_changed_supply_addresses.description:
The addresses and contracts data from Energiedirect no longer has the structure this integration expects ({detail}). Energiedirect probably changed its website, so the affected sensors may stop updating until the integration is updated.

Check whether there is an update for the Energiedirect integration, or report it at {issue_url}. This warning disappears by itself once the data can be read again.
